name: software-factory
description: A hands-off software factory: /software-factory:factory grills you first (grilling + ADRs), turns the epic into GitHub issues with native dependencies, builds independent tickets in parallel through role agents (spec-writer → builder → four parallel reviewers, one an adversary that tries to break the change with reproduced counterexamples → a one-at-a-time UX tester that runs the app locally and posts before/after screenshots on the PR for UI changes → approver), and merges only through pull requests — stacked when a blocker is approved but unmerged, flagged for human review when in doubt. State lives in the project's factory/ folder with a live dashboard.
